touch_record.source_claim: about 175 touches per session; 42% of touches hold
touch_record.page: REF p.5 (sixty, eighty, a hundred contracts in seconds); REF p.8 (41152 touches / 235 sessions = 175; 42% hold)

observed_rate_justification.text: REF p.8 prints 42% hold on 41152 NQ and MNQ touches over 235 RTH sessions Dec 24-Nov 25. The hold tick cutoff is not printed. Phase 1.5 labels hold with OD HOLD_BOUNDARY_TICKS=8 inside 30 minutes on NQ only, on 15 calendar sessions that are not that 235-session window. The bound stays at 175 and 42%. The observed hold rate is the OD label on this slice, not a rewrite of the paper.
